terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Six generated views expose the full footprint and top layout. Exact four-way symmetry removes hidden-side ambiguity.

reasoning: The prop combines stacked architectural masses with distinct basin, pedestal, bowl, finial, and water layers.
Four fish spouts, four recessed panels, eight base seams, and eight finial flutes form repeated radial systems.
Unity review needs compound colliders, water surfaces, and stable emitter sockets while remaining mobile-safe.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Rotational symmetry is simple to parameterize, but the layered tiers, repeated ornaments, transparent water, and runtime sockets require a deep explicit spec.

details.description: Rounded chamfer catching a warm highlight on both octagonal steps.
Eight radial stone joints segment each octagonal plinth ring.
Thick rounded lower-basin lip with a broad cream highlight.
Dark inner channel beneath the cream basin lip.
Four dark-teal recessed trapezoid panels in the pedestal faces.
Round fish-mouth outlet at the end of each stylized spout.
Paired raised eye beads on each fish-head spout.
Raised rounded crest on the upper bowl rim.
Eight shallow vertical flutes on the acorn finial.
Low-roughness concentric and radial ripple highlights on both water surfaces.
Very subtle warm and cool limestone mottling with cavity-biased darkening.
Muted brown-red copper rings with restrained teal patina in lower cavities.

definitionOfDone: All six views read as one 2.6 m octagonal two-tier fountain with the same four-spout and four-panel rotational system.
The optimized LOD0 retains the plinth, lower pool, faceted pedestal, four fish spouts, upper bowl, water disks, copper bands, and finial at or below 25k triangles and five materials.
Unity receives stable water and spout sockets, compound colliders, a decreasing three-level LODGroup, and an isolated review scene.

featureGroups.name: Octagonal tiered fountain silhouette
qualityCriteria: A wide two-step octagonal base supports a round lower basin, narrower faceted tower, smaller upper bowl, and compact finial.

featureGroups.name: Lower basin, pedestal, and upper bowl hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Every tier visibly overlaps or embeds into its supporting tier with no floating gaps.

featureGroups.name: Four fish spouts and four recessed panels
qualityCriteria: Four evenly spaced teal fish heads project from alternating pedestal faces and align with four dark-teal inset panels and emitter sockets.

featureGroups.name: Warm limestone, teal ceramic, water, and copper response
qualityCriteria: Stone is matte and subtly mottled, water is glossy and translucent, teal panels are glazed, and copper rings remain small metallic accents.

visualDeltaChecks: octagonal footprint and radial seam delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not merge the four spout sockets or water surfaces into the pedestal mesh.
Do not represent the octagonal seams, panel recesses, fish mouths, finial flutes, or water ripples as prose only.
Do not continue when any basin, ring, or spout has a visible attachment gap.
Do not exceed the 25k triangle, five material, or eight draw-call target after Blender optimization.

mustMatch: warm limestone, teal water/ceramic, and copper material separation
recognizable basin lips, panel recesses, fish mouths, and finial

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Wide octagonal base and two-tier fountain silhouette
Attached basin, tower, upper bowl, and finial hierarchy
Four fish spouts and four recessed teal panels
Limestone, ceramic, water, and copper surface response
Tier and spout readability at isometric gameplay distance

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: The generated turnaround is a concept specification rather than calibrated photogrammetry.
Four-way rotational symmetry from the top view controls hidden-side reconstruction.
Water jets and impact ripples are runtime effects; the structural export retains water disks and emitter sockets.

albedo.samplingNotes: Reference-derived from foreground pixels; de-lit to reduce baked shadows/highlights.

textureProjection.texelDensityIntent: Stable object-scale detail; no stretching across differently scaled tiers.

surfaceFrequencyBands.role: reference-derived broad albedo and height breakup
reference-derived cracks, ridges, pores, grain, or leaf clusters
reference-derived micro highlight breakup under grazing light

roughness.localResponse: reference-derived roughness estimate; cavities and textured zones trend rougher, bright highlights trend smoother

ambientOcclusion.notes: Reference-derived cavity estimate from local height minima; verify against grazing-light screenshot.

localOverrides.region: broad exposed stone faces and cavity contacts

localOverrides.notes: Use generated maps as material evidence, then refine after browser screenshot comparison.

shaderNotes: Prefer MeshPhysicalMaterial when clearcoat, sheen, transmission, or thin-surface response is observed; otherwise use MeshStandardMaterial-compatible PBR channels.
Generate albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO independently; never alias albedo into roughness.
Use normal/bump/displacement only when they map to observed surface relief.
Use displacement geometry when the observed relief changes the close-up silhouette; texture-only relief is insufficient there.
Reference-derived maps are estimates from image pixels; verify with neutral, grazing, and reference-matched renders.
Do not treat baked image shadows as final albedo; rerun extraction with a tighter material crop if highlights/shadows pollute the maps.

referencePbr.method: single-image pixel evidence with de-lighting estimate; not photogrammetry
referencePbr.hardLimit: A single image cannot uniquely recover true albedo/roughness/normal/AO; maps are reference-derived estimates.

acceptance: Silhouette reads correctly without materials.
Quality contract has named all required macro feature groups before code generation.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Build the component hierarchy implied by the pre-spec complexity assessment.
acceptance: Macro, meso, and repeated structures meet qualityContract.minimumSpecDepth.
Parent-child relations, joints, seams, sockets, and contact points are explicit.
Every attached child appendage/connector has parentSocket, localStart/localEnd, contactType, embedDepth or overlap, and gapTolerance.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Refine shape, deformation, bevels, tapers, curves, asymmetry, and visible local geometry.
acceptance: Important visible forms are represented in component geometryDescriptor, deformations, localFeatures, or repetitionSystems.
Endpoint-based child parts are rooted at their attachment sockets and do not visibly float away from parents.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.
Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.
Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.
A grazing-angle close-up proves that normal/height detail breaks highlights naturally and does not read as smooth plastic.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.
Exposure, tone mapping, background color/gradient, shadow softness, and contact shadow behavior are specified.
Lighting does not hide geometry/material gaps and screenshots can be compared fairly to the reference.
Neutral, grazing, and reference-matched lighting checks distinguish material errors from lighting errors.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.
Sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata are present for future runtime actions.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Protect runtime performance after visual fidelity is accepted.
acceptance: Triangle count, draw calls, instancing, LOD strategy, and FPS target are documented or verified.
Repeated detail is instanced or simplified where possible without breaking silhouette/material believability.

featureReviews.notes: The wide octagonal two-step base, round lower basin, narrowed faceted tower, compact upper bowl, and finial establish the intended tier hierarchy. The upper bowl and finial remain deliberately coarse at blockout.

visualEvidence.notes: Compared against the full six-view sheet with emphasis on the three-quarter panel.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The primary silhouette passes: base width, lower pool diameter, tower taper, upper tier, and central finial are all recognizable. Coarse upper-tier curvature belongs to a later pass.

featureReviews.notes: The plinth, lower basin, pedestal base/body/cap, upper bowl, water disks, and finial overlap cleanly with no visible floating tier.
Four radial spout roots visibly embed into the tower and the four inset panels sit flush on matching faces; fish anatomy is intentionally deferred to form refinement.

visualEvidence.notes: Structural review focuses on contacts, radial counts, and hierarchy rather than polished ornament.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The attachment gate passes: the tower and bowls have visible contact, the four spout necks penetrate the pedestal, and inset panels sit against the faces without air gaps.

featureReviews.notes: The tier proportions remain recognizable, but the finial flute meshes form a spiky crown that breaks the compact acorn silhouette.
Tier attachment remains sound, but several dark radial seam strips protrude beyond the octagonal plinth edges and read as floating tabs.

visualEvidence.notes: Failed feature-level silhouette acceptance despite a globally recognizable fountain.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The mismatch is implementation-local: the spec calls for shallow finial flutes and recessed stone seams, but the meshes are oversized and protruding.

featureReviews.notes: The corrected finial is a compact faceted acorn form, the upper bowl is compressed, and no repeated detail breaks the main silhouette.
The lower basin, tapered tower, upper bowl, copper rings, and finial remain attached, while the stone seams now stay within the octagonal steps.

visualEvidence.notes: Corrected screenshot compared against the same six-view sheet.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The prior silhouette defects are removed. The form now reads as the same stylized fountain with a complete radial ornament and water-jet system.

featureReviews.notes: Limestone, teal ceramic, dark panels, water, and copper have distinct PBR values, but the lower copper band is exposed only as disconnected scallops because its torus intersects the octagonal pedestal.

visualEvidence.notes: Material gate fails only on the fragmented lower copper accent.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The palette and roughness hierarchy are sound and limestone reference extraction passed at 0.909 confidence. The copper defect is caused by an intersecting primitive, not by the material spec.

featureReviews.notes: Warm matte limestone dominates, glossy teal ceramic and water separate by roughness, dark-teal panels read as recesses, and the copper accent is now one continuous restrained band.

visualEvidence.notes: Material zones and reflectance roles pass after correcting the copper intersection.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The palette hierarchy matches the concept and the PBR extraction confidence is 0.909. Independent roughness and normal fields are specified and will be judged in the grazing surface pass.

featureReviews.notes: Grazing light shows independent fine limestone roughness/normal breakup, glossy ceramic highlights, dark panel cavities, and ripple-normal response on visible water strips without photoreal grunge.

visualEvidence.notes: Camera was raised after the first capture so the water, spout, rim, and stone surfaces could be judged together.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: Independent normal and roughness maps break the limestone and ceramic highlights. The effect is restrained and remains free of obvious tiling or baked-light artifacts.

featureReviews.notes: Warm upper-left key light reveals limestone bevels and grain, glossy teal spouts and water, dark recesses, and the small copper band without clipping highlights.
The wide base, bright rim, dark tower panels, teal water ring, and compact top tier remain distinct at the review framing and against the light studio background.

visualEvidence.notes: Lighting was judged after neutral material and raised grazing-angle checks.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The key/fill/rim structure explains the tiers and material response, while the background and contact shadow keep the prop readable at isometric-game scale.

featureReviews.notes: The top view verifies four evenly spaced fish-spout modules and matching tower faces at exact 90-degree intervals; the effect sockets point radially into the lower basin.
The concentric tier silhouette, four-way interaction layout, bright limestone rim, and teal water remain legible from the high isometric gameplay angle.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Preserve tier silhouette, basin lips, four spouts, panel recesses, water disks, and finial; instance radial details and create strictly decreasing LODs.

lightingFromPhoto: Key light: large warm area/directional light from camera-left and above, approximately 4800 K, intensity 3.0, soft shadow radius.
Fill light: cool neutral hemisphere or large area fill from camera-right, intensity 0.75.
Rim/environment: soft teal-neutral rear-right rim and low-contrast studio environment reflection.
Output: ACES Filmic tone mapping, exposure +0.2, light gray background, soft contact shadow and ambient occlusion beneath the octagonal base.
proceduralStrategy: Build the stepped octagonal plinth, round basin masses, faceted tower, upper bowl, and finial as parameterized cylinders, tori, lathe profiles, and beveled extrusions.
Instance four fish-spout modules and four inset-panel modules around the pedestal with exact 90 degree spacing.
Generate limestone and water roughness/normal fields independently from albedo using deterministic seeds.
Expose water surfaces and six effect sockets separately from structural meshes.
Export named hierarchy to GLB with +Z forward, +Y up, meter scale, then create LOD1/LOD2 and material consolidation in Blender.
